english_policy.notes.2: The current MCDS page requires recent TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo evidence for applicable non-native speakers, with no study-based waiver. It does not publish a current numerical hard minimum. English thresholds remain unknown; typical admitted-score ranges are not minima.

fact_summary: The Fall 2027 program page requires English evidence and points to SCS policy; the currently retrievable page does not establish a numerical minimum.
